meta.title: Poswal Orbit · Your whole day, in orbit
meta.description: A calm, offline-first personal workspace for habits, tasks and notes on Android. True RTL support, zero trackers, and zero accounts.

features.title: Built for focus, engineered for permanence
features.subtitle: Six verified modules working together without server reliance.
features.todayDesc: A single timeline merging habits and tasks due today with a visual progress ring.
features.habitsDesc: EWMA consistency scores, streak freeze protection, and a 14-week visual check-in heatmap.
features.tasksDesc: Plain sentence parsing, checklist subtasks, priority levels, and flexible repeats.
features.notesDesc: Live syntax styling with dimmed markdown tokens and integrated checklist toggling.
features.remindersDesc: 7-day rolling notifications with health check status and native home screen widgets.
features.safetyDesc: 7-day automatic backup rotation, transactional JSON exports, and Loop CSV migration.

design.title: Liquid Glass on Apple HIG
design.subtitle: Frosted glass only on control surfaces, solid high-contrast content, and concentric corner geometry.
design.concentricDesc: Outer radius equals inner radius plus inset padding for seamless optical harmony.
design.disclaimer: Inspired by Apple's Human Interface Guidelines. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

privacy.title: Verify, do not trust
privacy.subtitle: Your data never leaves your device because release builds do not request network permission.
privacy.point1Desc: Release builds omit the INTERNET permission entirely from AndroidManifest.xml. Debug and CI test builds may request it for developer tooling.
privacy.point2Desc: All habits, tasks, and notes stay in an on-device Drift SQLite database.
privacy.point3Desc: No Firebase, no crash telemetry, and no advertising SDKs are bundled.
privacy.verifyStep2: Check manifest: cat android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml | grep INTERNET
privacy.verifyStep3: Inspect APK: aapt dump permissions poswal-orbit.apk

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. Release builds do not declare or request the INTERNET permission. Data cannot leave the device unless you explicitly export or share it.
faq.q2: Why does the day start at 4:00 AM?
faq.a2: To protect late-night productivity. Any check-in between midnight and 3:59 AM counts toward the previous day, preventing accidental streak breaks.
faq.q3: How can I back up my data?
faq.a3: The app automatically keeps the last 7 daily backup snapshots in local storage. You can also export a full JSON or CSV backup at any time in Settings.
faq.q4: When will the iOS version be available?
faq.a4: The Swift widgets and Flutter iOS code are complete, but hardware verification on a physical Mac and iPhone is required before publishing.
